name: D · Area
premise: No figure: a measured area getting smaller, drawn as an acid plot shrinking inside its own before-outline, with its error band.

items.title: Shrink inside the plot
items.note: S1 2 S2 2 S3 1 S4 2 S5 1 S6 2 S7 2 = 12. Acid area inside its grey before-outline, anchored to a corner. Reads smaller at once; the outline is the before, not a true tolerance band.

items.title: Plot with error band
items.note: S1 2 S2 2 S3 1 S4 1 S5 2 S6 2 S7 1 = 11. As 16 plus an amber hairline band round the result. Only candidate with a real band at 1024; at 64 the amber ring crowds the solid.

items.title: Shrinking cell grid
items.note: S1 1 S2 2 S3 1 S4 2 S5 0 S6 2 S7 2 = 10. 4x4 squares each smaller than the last: area literally diminishing. No band; risks reading as a loading or halftone glyph.

items.title: Plot, amber before
items.note: S1 2 S2 2 S3 1 S4 2 S5 1 S6 2 S7 2 = 12. 16 with the before-outline in amber. Palette variant; amber outline outweighs the acid mass a little.

items.title: Heptagon shrink
items.note: S1 2 S2 2 S3 1 S4 2 S5 1 S6 2 S7 2 = 12. Seven-sided plot; more gem than parcel, so less distinct than 16.

items.title: Three shrinking plots
items.note: S1 2 S2 2 S3 1 S4 1 S5 1 S6 2 S7 1 = 10. Two ghost outlines then the solid: a progression. Muddy at 64.

items.title: Half solid, half band
items.note: S1 1 S2 1 S3 2 S4 2 S5 2 S6 2 S7 1 = 11. Left half acid, right half only its amber band. Reads half-moon more than smaller.

items.title: Counted cells
items.note: S1 1 S2 1 S3 1 S4 2 S5 0 S6 2 S7 2 = 9. Acid cells kept, hollow grey cells lost. Below gate: no band, reads as a generic grid.

items.title: Frozen pixel scan
items.note: S1 1 S2 1 S3 1 S4 2 S5 0 S6 2 S7 2 = 9. Filled rows above a scan line, hollow below. Below gate: reads as a grid, no band.

items.title: Misregistered area
items.note: S1 1 S2 0 S3 2 S4 2 S5 1 S6 2 S7 1 = 9. Bold solid pentagon with an offset amber outline as the error. Below gate: says error, not smaller.

items.title: Dashed band
items.note: S1 1 S2 1 S3 0 S4 2 S5 0 S6 2 S7 1 = 7. Solid plot in a dashed amber band. Below gate: dashes shimmer at 64 and the band becomes the main read.
